Interviewer: This intake is for the Republic of Alderhaven, a fictional demonstration jurisdiction.
Interviewer: What do you want changed about the existing parenting arrangement?
Caller: Share the driving for visits equally.
Caller: My name is Aven Fern. The other parent is Nell Fern.
Caller: I live at 26 Sample Rise, Demo Borough.
Caller: Osa Fern born 2018-03-13 is our child.
Caller: The existing order carries the date 2024-04-15.
Interviewer: Do you have replacement days or times for a proposed schedule?
Caller: No, I have not chosen any days or times. I cannot give a schedule yet.
